description.narrative: NSD - LRC In order to increase its financial sustainability, LRC wishes to pilot a new cost recovery scheme. This will be achieved through the set-up of a Training and Development Centre through which LRC will develop and deliver advanced trainings to movement and non-movement actors as well as allow access to international certifications. LRC will charge external entities for the delivered trainings ensuring thus financial returns and operational sustainability of the centre and, more importantly, a sustainable internal capacity building opportunity to LRC staff and volunteers - one of LRC' main NSD goals. BRC funding is part of a larger support to LRC by different stakeholders. BRC' share will be used to cover equipment, training software to support populating their newly established LMS, capacity building of L&D team and acquisition of international certifications related so some globally accredited courses. The NSD funds will be used in 2023.
